easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, South Wind Avatar's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Trudge Garden and South Wind Avatar's second ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Trudge Garden trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Repeat from step 3.
